title: Practice 6: Perfective or imperfective? The prefixed verbs in use

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: I spent my vacation in Hakone.
exercises.why: **провел** — past tense (masculine) of провести: perfective (imperfective partner: проводить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).
**подлетал** — past tense (masculine) of подлетать: imperfective (perfective partner: подлететь).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).

exercises.q: He came in fifth in the race.
exercises.why: **пришел** — past tense (masculine) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Tom raised his glass to his lips.
exercises.why: **поднёс** — past tense (masculine) of поднести: perfective (imperfective partner: подносить).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).

**пришла** — past tense (feminine) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: The investigation has hit a dead end.
exercises.why: **зашло** — past tense (neuter) of зайти: perfective (imperfective partner: заходить).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).
**ушёл** — past tense (masculine) of уйти: perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
**сошёл** — past tense (masculine) of сойти: perfective (imperfective partner: сходить).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: Tom brought the cup to his lips.
exercises.why: **поднёс** — past tense (masculine) of поднести: perfective (imperfective partner: подносить).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).

exercises.q: The conversation lasted until after midnight.
exercises.why: **зашла** — past tense (feminine) of зайти: perfective (imperfective partner: заходить).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: Tom unlocked the door and went in.
exercises.why: **вошёл** — past tense (masculine) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
**влез** — past tense (masculine) of влезть: perfective (imperfective partner: влезать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: The gazelle ran away from the cheetah.
exercises.why: **убежала** — past tense (feminine) of убежать: perfective (imperfective partner: убегать).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: The moon emerged from behind the cloud.
exercises.why: **выплыла** — past tense (feminine) of выплыть: perfective (imperfective partner: выплывать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: The sun went below the horizon.
exercises.why: **зашло** — past tense (neuter) of зайти: perfective (imperfective partner: заходить).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: An explosion blew the house apart.
exercises.why: **разнёс** — past tense (masculine) of разнести: perfective (imperfective partner: разносить).  Prefix **раз-, разо-, рас- (+сь, +ся)**: divergent movement in various directions from one center (по + dat. pl.; в + acc. pl).
**улетел** — past tense (masculine) of улететь: perfective (imperfective partner: улетать).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: The moon rose above the clouds.
exercises.why: **выплыла** — past tense (feminine) of выплыть: perfective (imperfective partner: выплывать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
**ввели** — past tense (plural) of ввести: perfective (imperfective partner: вводить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
